jobs.title: Audiovisual Technician – Conferences 100% - Permanent Contract
jobs.company: FONDATION DES IMMEUBLES POUR LES ORGANISATIONS INTERNATIONALES
jobs.description: At the heart of international Geneva, the International Conference Centre, Geneva (CICG) and the Varembé Conference Centre (CCV) host major events bringing together international organisations, institutions, public partners and actors of multilateral dialogue. Managed by FIPOI, these venues are genuine platforms for meetings, exchanges and outreach for Geneva.   To strengthen our technical team and support the development of our activities, we are looking for: An Audiovisual Technician – Conferences 100% - Permanent Contract   Your mission Reporting to the Conference Service and integrated into an experienced and committed audiovisual team, you contribute to the preparation, operation and reliability of the technical installations of our conference centres. Your objective: to ensure, together with the entire team, a smooth and high-quality audiovisual experience for our clients, partners, service providers and visitors. Beyond technical expertise, we value the way we work together: mutual support, communication, availability and good humour are part of everyday life, even during busy periods.   Your main responsibilities In this role, you will notably be required to: Prepare, configure and supervise the control rooms, rooms and audiovisual equipment of the CICG and CCV (audio, video, simultaneous interpretation systems, audiovisual networks); Ensure monitoring, control and preventive and corrective maintenance of equipment, and participate in diagnosing and resolving technical incidents with the team and relevant partners; Respond to the technical needs of clients, suppliers, service providers and visitors with responsiveness and a service-oriented approach, and occasionally operate the installations during conferences and events, either in the control room or in the room; Propose improvements and contribute to the evolution of our equipment, working methods and quality standards; participate in the technical and administrative follow-up of the service.   Your profile Training in audio, video or audiovisual professions, complemented by around 5 years or more of experience in an audiovisual role, ideally in events, conferences or a demanding technical environment; Strong knowledge of audio, video, lighting, IT and audiovisual signal processing; proficiency with office tools; capturing, filming and post-production: a plus; Knowledge of simultaneous interpretation systems (mastery of Televic solutions is an asset) and good knowledge of audiovisual networks, notably DANTE, as well as AV over IP environments. Very good command of French and good command of English, including technical vocabulary; Reliable, responsible and autonomous personality, solution- and service-oriented, with rigour, responsiveness and ability to manage priorities in demanding situations. True team spirit (mutual support, communication, constructive attitude), curiosity and willingness to learn continuously; Flexibility and availability to support activity needs, including occasional evening, weekend or public holiday hours; knowledge of the international environment: an asset.   Why join us? Joining FIPOI means becoming part of a Foundation serving international Geneva, carrying a public interest mission and active in a multicultural, demanding and stimulating environment. You will join a human-sized organisation of about 70 employees, where service quality, collaboration and continuous improvement are essential. We offer you a varied technical position at the heart of international events and conferences, professional audiovisual installations, an experienced, supportive and committed team where mutual support and good humour have a real place, large-scale projects serving international organisations, active support for continuing education, as well as quality social benefits and a working environment recognised by the Great Place to Work® approach.   Application We look forward to receiving your application (CV and cover letter) via the JobUp platform. Application deadline: 16 October 2026.

jobs.title: Senior Event Manager
jobs.description: People at 1800 metres above sea level shape luxury mountain travel. Our dynamic and international team offers our guests smart luxury for an unparalleled holiday experience. As a team member of the luxurious Kulm Group, you are part of the key to our success. Together we make every stay inspiring, unique and distinctive. And as such, we live our culture: discreet luxury, inspiration and life experience. Together we make this possible. This is your chance to become part of our defining culture: What you will achieve with us Elegant gala dinners, exclusive weddings, high-profile business events and bespoke celebrations – across two of Switzerland’s most renowned establishments. As a Senior Event Manager , you will oversee the entire planning process from enquiry to operational handover, ensuring that every event at both the Kulm Hotel St. Moritz and the Grand Hotel Kronenhof Pontresina is precisely planned, efficiently coordinated and flawlessly executed. Your responsibilities: Operational detailed planning & implementation: Seamless takeover of confirmed bookings from Sales; detailed coordination of all processes including room concepts, F&B procedures, technology and individual guest requests. Hub within the house: Accurate creation and timely distribution of Function Sheets (BEOs) as well as daily close coordination with Banqueting, Kitchen, Service, Technical Services and Front Office of both establishments. Presence & on-site support: Point of contact for organisers and clients during the event on site, conducting briefings on location and ensuring smooth operations. Interface: Preparation and leadership of internal event meetings to ensure all operational departments are perfectly briefed and prepared. Leadership & quality: Leadership and development of the Event Coordinator as well as co-creation of clear operational standards and templates. Follow-up: Recording all services provided in the PMS/CRM to prepare error-free final billing. Who you are Education & experience: Ideally a bachelor’s degree or training in hospitality, event management or business administration, with at least three years’ experience in hotel events or event planning, preferably focusing on meetings, incentives, weddings and private celebrations in the luxury segment. Organisational talent: Exceptional attention to detail, a confident sense of priorities and the ability to manage multiple projects simultaneously. Process & system knowledge: Proficient use of PMS, CRM and event management systems as well as excellent Microsoft Office 365 skills. Personality: Reliable, solution-oriented and resilient; you build sustainable relationships with discerning guests as well as all operational departments. Language skills: Fluent and polished German and English, both spoken and written; additional languages are an advantage. Start date: October or by arrangement. If you would like to help shape the future of the event sector within the Kulm Group, we look forward to receiving your complete application documents. Benefits At the Kulm Group, our employees are at the heart of our success. We offer attractive development opportunities, comfortable accommodation, affordable meals in the staff restaurant, and numerous discounts.

jobs.title: Responsable de la bibliothèque à 90%
jobs.description: Prenant soin d'une collection de plus de 76'000 objets et de près de 300'000 documents (livres, supports photographiques, enregistrements sonores et musicaux) couvrant tous les continents, le Musée d'ethnographie de Genève (MEG) est un lieu incontournable de la scène culturelle genevoise. Son programme d'expositions et sa programmation culturelle et scientifique pluridisciplinaires valorisent les savoirs, abordent les enjeux sociétaux et environnementaux contemporains et incitent à repenser la relation au vivant. Afin de compléter son équipe, le MEG recherche un ou une Responsable de la bibliothèque à 90% Votre mission et vos responsabilités - Assurer le fonctionnement général de la bibliothèque de manière autonome, et en accord avec la ou le Responsable de l'Unité Publics, sur les plans administratif, financier et en matière de ressources humaines. - Proposer et mettre en oeuvre des projets qui contribuent au développement de la bibliothèque et du MEG. - Coordonner et garantir la mise en oeuvre de la politique des collections (acquisitions, classification, restauration, élimination). - Élaborer et participer aux actions de formation, de médiation et de communication interne et externe de la bibliothèque : internet, réseaux sociaux, affichage, etc. Votre profil - Être titulaire d'un Bachelor en sciences de l'information, ou d'une formation jugée équivalente. Une formation continue en management constitue un atout. - Justifier d'une expérience professionnelle d'au minimum 5 ans dans un poste similaire, incluant une expérience en management d'équipe. - Maîtriser le SIGB Alma et les règles de catalogage en vigueur dans le réseau SLSP, et être à l'aise avec les outils informatiques usuels. - Porter un intérêt marqué pour les sciences sociales (ethnographie, anthropologie, sciences politiques et sciences du développement) et être capable de thématiser des sujets de société. - Maîtriser parfaitement le français, avoir de bonnes connaissances de l'anglais à l'oral comme à l'écrit, la maîtrise d'une troisième langue constituant un atout. - Être force de proposition pour diversifier les publics de la Bibliothèque et mettre en oeuvre un programme de médiation culturelle et scientifique. - Être constructif, constructive et ouvert ou ouverte, afin de collaborer efficacement avec des équipes pluridisciplinaires et de nombreux partenaires, même dans des situations de stress. - Savoir mobiliser une équipe par l'écoute et le dialogue afin d'instaurer un climat de confiance et de créer un environnement de travail positif et stimulant. - Accepter de travailler occasionnellement le week-end. La Ville de Genève souhaite promouvoir la mixité dans toute sa diversité et ce, dans tous les services de l'administration. Pourquoi nous rejoindre ? En rejoignant la Bibliothèque du MEG – Bibliothèque Marie Madeleine Lancoux, vous intégrerez une équipe engagée et professionnelle au sein d'une bibliothèque spécialisée en anthropologie sociale et culturelle. Vous pourrez contribuer pleinement à ses missions scientifiques, pédagogiques et patrimoniales, en participant à la valorisation de collections uniques et à l'accompagnement de publics variés. Dans sa volonté de lutter contre le chômage, la ville encourage les candidatures provenant de l'Office cantonal de l'emploi. Suivi des postulations En Ville de Genève, le processus de recrutement est décentralisé. Cela signifie que chaque service ou département est responsable du suivi des candidatures pour les postes qu'il propose. Un accusé de réception sera envoyé aux candidates et candidats. Conditions d'engagement Les employées et employés de la Ville de Genève doivent être domiciliées et domiciliés dans la zone de domiciliation autorisée et être au bénéfice d'un permis ou d'une autorisation de travail valable.. This is a highly operational role offering exposure to content marketing, creative production, digital campaigns, webinars, podcasts and community engagement. Based in Zurich, the organization brings together experts, researchers and healthcare professionals from across the world to advance knowledge, education and collaboration within its field. Manage content and campaign calendars to ensure consistent and timely messaging across all channels. Partner with internal stakeholders to deliver communication initiatives aligned with organizational priorities. Ensure all communications and creative materials are aligned with brand guidelines and tone of voice. Coordinate the production of marketing materials with external agencies, designers and suppliers. Create, distribute and optimize email marketing campaigns, including audience segmentation and performance tracking. Maintain and update website content through the organization's content management system. Support paid and organic digital initiatives designed to increase visibility and audience engagement. Multimedia, Events & Educational Content Assist in the production and promotion of webinars, virtual events and educational initiatives. Contribute to podcast and video projects, including content preparation, editing coordination and publication. Repurpose multimedia content into engaging digital formats to maximize audience reach. jobs.title: Curator Ethnographic Collection 80%
jobs.description: The Bern Historical Museum is one of the most important cultural history museums in Switzerland. It is a growing repository of knowledge and experience for the culture and history of Bern and the world. The collections on history, archaeology, and ethnography comprise around 567,000 objects. They offer insights into living environments from different historical periods and cultural contexts. The integrated Einstein Museum places the life and work of the physicist in the context of world history. The museum is facing major changes and exciting challenges with the planned renovation and comprehensive museal renewal. The goal is to reopen the museum in 2032 as a vibrant house of history with diverse mediation formats, new access to the Bern museum quarter, and a high quality of stay. We are looking for a Curator Ethnographic Collection 80% with a focus on Africa and an additional focus on orientalist collections. In the team, you will manage the third largest ethnographic collection in Switzerland, which comprises around 65,000 objects from Asia, Africa, America, Europe, and Oceania. You are a historian or cultural scientist with an interest in museological questions and have proven expertise in Africa and/or Central Asia. Experience with provenance research is a welcome plus. You will be responsible for the following tasks: Contributing to the definition of collection policy Accessing and researching the collection holdings Maintaining the collection inventory and object documentation Ensuring the proper storage of the collection holdings in collaboration with the conservation-restoration team Content curation and collaboration in designing and implementing mediation offers, such as exhibitions, events, participatory offers, especially with regard to the exhibition/mediation programme for the museum's reopening in 2032 Cooperation with partner institutions and source communities regarding the BHM collection Preparing and conducting tours through permanent and temporary exhibitions Writing texts for a specialist audience and the general public Managing objects in loan traffic, including courier services domestically and abroad What you bring: A completed university degree (at least Master’s level) in history, cultural and social sciences, or social anthropology, as well as a broad interest in the subject area and in-depth knowledge of Africa and/or Central Asia, are prerequisites for application. Thanks to your several years of professional experience in museums, you are well acquainted with curatorial practice and current discourses in the museum world. You maintain a global-historical approach to the collection, reflect on the function and significance of museal collection holdings, ideally already have a relevant network for the role, and are also willing to engage with new subject areas. You also bring experience in project management and collaboration on exhibitions. As a communicative personality, continuous exchange within the scientific team as well as interdisciplinary cooperation with specialists from all other museum areas is important to you. You greatly enjoy passing on your knowledge vividly to professionals as well as to our museum guests. Very good foreign language skills in French and English (additional collection-relevant languages are a plus), a structured working method, a high awareness of quality, and a confident handling of museum databases complete your profile. We look forward to receiving your complete application (cover letter, CV, certificates) by 25 October 2026. In the cover letter, please briefly describe your professional and personal competencies, your museum experience, as well as your expectations and goals for the advertised position. Further information is provided by Saskia Klaassen, Head of Collections, 031 350 77 54.
